title: Singapore City Lights and Ocean Nights | Genting Dream Cruise
highlights: Explore Singapore, a city known for its futuristic skyline, lush gardens, diverse cuisine, and rich culture, blending tradition with modernity.
Discover the Helix Bridge, an architectural marvel in Singapore, featuring a stunning double-helix design that beautifully lights up at night,
Visit Universal Studios Singapore, a thrilling theme park featuring exciting rides, captivating shows, and beloved characters.
Set sail on the Genting Dream cruise, where luxury meets adventure with world-class dining, entertainment, and stunning ocean views,
Experience the Night Safari at Singapore Zoo, the world's first nocturnal zoo, where you can observe nocturnal animals in their natural habitat amidst lush scenery.
inclusions: Transfer from Singapore Changi Airport to Deluxe Hotel
3 nights stay in Singapore with breakfast

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Welcome to Singapore | Enjoy the Night Safari
days.desc: Welcome to Singapore! Upon arrival at Changi International Airport, get transferred to your hotel. Check-in and rest for some time. In the evening, get driven to Singapore Zoo for an exciting Night Safari experience, the world's first nocturnal zoo. There, you can explore over 900 animals in their natural habitats via walking trails. Next, enjoy a tram ride through the jungle and a night show at the park before being transferred back to the hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

days.title: Half Day Singapore City Tour | Trip to Sentosa Island
days.desc: Today, get driven on a city tour. Explore the diverse artworks at the Art Museum, marvel at the DNA-shaped architecture of the Helix Bridge & relax at the Merlion Park. Explore other sites before being transferred to Universal Studios on Sentosa Island. Enjoy a full day at the island, where you can relax on its beaches or indulge in thrilling attractions like the S.E.A. Aquarium & Madame Tussauds Wax Museum. You can also catch the Wings of Time show before being driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
days.desc: In the morning, get transferred to Universal Studios. Discover incredible movie-themed park, featuring over 24 rides and attractions across 7 themed zones. Experience thrilling roller coaster rides, enjoy street performances and live shows, and don't forget to take pictures with your favorite Hollywood characters. After a fun filled day, get transferred back to the hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

days.title: Embark on the Genting Dream Cruise
days.desc: Today, check out from the hotel and get transferred to Marina Bay Cruise Center to board the Genting Dream Cruise. Upon arrival, check in and take in the scenic views of the ocean and the cityscape. You can take part in various onboard activities like ziplining over the ocean at the Rope Course & Zipline or take a chance at rock climbing. End your night with a DJ party at Zouk & Zouk Beach Club. Afterward, savor a delicious dinner at The Lido and enjoy a peaceful night on the cruise.

days.title: Leisure Day on the Cruise
days.desc: Today, begin your day by witnessing a beautiful sunrise over the ocean. Spend the day relaxing on the deck or indulge in various onboard activities. Unwind at the Crystal Life Spa for some pampering, or have fun on the thrilling waterslides. Don’t miss the live shows at the Zodiac Theatre, featuring a range of performances. As the day comes to a close, enjoy a delicious dinner aboard the cruise and rest for the night.

days.title: Disembark from the Cruise | Departure
days.desc: In the morning, disembark from the cruise and get transferred to the Singapore Airport. Continue your journey onward and this marks the end of your trip.
